title: Big River
hook: Boots 的红靴子被河水冲走了，Dora 和他坐上小船，一路划过大河去追它。

cells.en: Dora stands on the dock and fishes. Fish jump up. “Yeah, there's some!”
cells.cn: Dora 站在码头上钓鱼，小鱼一条条蹦起来：“对，有鱼！”

cells.en: “Dora, my boot is floating away!” The red boot drifts down the river.
cells.cn: “Dora，我的靴子漂走了！”红靴子顺着大河漂下去。

cells.en: “My boot! My boot!” Boots cries. They run after the little red boot.
cells.cn: “我的靴子！我的靴子！”Boots 大叫，他们追着那只小红靴跑。

cells.en: “Look, there's your boot!” Dora and Boots row their boat to the bridge.
cells.cn: “看，你的靴子在那儿！”Dora 和 Boots 划着小船来到桥边。

cells.en: “We go past all those branches!” Dora and Boots row very fast.
cells.cn: “我们穿过那些树枝啦！”Dora 和 Boots 飞快地划船。

cells.en: Boots sees the big waterfall. “Oh, no!” The water is very loud.
cells.cn: Boots 看见前面的大瀑布：“糟糕！”水声好响。

cells.en: “We make it past the waterfall!” Dora and Boots cheer in the boat.
cells.cn: “我们冲过瀑布啦！”Dora 和 Boots 在船上欢呼。

cells.en: Dora holds a fishing rod. “Come on, Boots!” They row to the red boot.
cells.cn: Dora 拿着鱼竿：“来吧，Boots！”他们朝红靴子划过去。

cells.en: “But we found it!” Boots has his red boots on again.
cells.cn: “可是我们找到它啦！”Boots 的红靴子又穿回脚上了。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Big River”.
ending: In the end, Boots gets his red boot back. My favorite part is ______.
